texts.sv_au_denied: Nyirabyo, umugenzuzi cyangwa umucungamari ni bo bonyine bashobora gufungura igenzura.
texts.sv_au_intro: Buri gikorwa cy'iyi konti. Buri gihe uru rupapuro rurebwe birandikwa.
texts.sv_bc_cost: Ibi bizakoresha ubutumwa bugufi {n} bwishyurwa. Genzura mbere yo kohereza.
texts.sv_bc_intro: Ubutumwa bumwe bwihutirwa ku itsinda ryose, binyuze mu nzira buri muntu akoresha.
texts.sv_bc_limits: Inyuguti zigera kuri {chars}. Hasigaye {left} kuri {per_day} uyu munsi.
texts.sv_bc_owner_or_manager: Nyir'ubucuruzi cyangwa umuyobozi ni bo bonyine bohereza ubutumwa bwihutirwa.
texts.sv_bc_seen_how: Kubona bisobanura kubufungura muri porogaramu ya LynkOmni. Gufungura imeyili n'ubutumwa bugufi ntibikurikiranwa na rimwe.
texts.sv_bc_why_per_day: Wohereje ubutumwa bwihutirwa bw'uyu munsi. Ejo ushobora kohereza ubundi.
texts.sv_bin_intro: Ibyasibwe bimara hano iminsi {days}, hanyuma bikavanwaho burundu.
texts.sv_bin_never: Inyemezabuguzi zatanzwe, inyandiko z'inguzanyo, ibyanditswe mu bitabo, ubwishyu, amajwi, inyandiko zasinywe n'ibiri mu irinda ry'amategeko ntibisibwa na rimwe.
texts.sv_box_bills_help: Fagitire yoherejwe ihinduka umushinga. Umuntu umwe arayuzuza, undi akayemeza.
texts.sv_box_files_help: Inyandiko yoherejwe ibikwa hamwe n'inyandiko zawe.
texts.sv_cal_intro: Amatariki ya buri serivisi ahantu hamwe. Gutumiza, ikiruhuko, imirimo, amasaha y'akazi, ubukode n'amafaranga y'ishuri bizongerwaho serivisi zabyo nizigera.
texts.sv_cs_links_help: Iyi miyoboro ikeneye uruhushya rwawe. Uzimije umwe, buri serivisi ihita ireka kuwukoresha.
texts.sv_cs_shared_help: Ubona amakuru yawe, ibyo abona n'igihe kugeza ryari.
texts.sv_ct_intro: Urutonde rumwe kuri buri serivisi. Amazina n'aho umuntu abonekera bibikwa mu bubiko burinzwe.
texts.sv_ei_allowed: Abohereza {n} wemereye ni bo bonyine banyuramo. Ibindi bigutegereje hano.
texts.sv_ei_intro: Ohereza imeyili kuri imwe muri aderesi izi kandi izagera aho igomba kujya.
texts.sv_hint_bc_text: Urugero: Uyu munsi turafungura saa 10:00 kubera imvura.
texts.sv_hint_mw_text: Urugero: Murakoze kugura kuri {business}. Tuzongera tubonane!
texts.sv_mi_ev_queue: Umurongo ni muremure kurusha uko bisanzwe
texts.sv_mi_intro: Imenyesha ry'uruhare rihagera rimwe gusa. Uwarifashe yerekwa abandi, kandi Byarangiye irikuraho kuri bose.
texts.sv_mr_intro: Uko ubutumwa bwawe bwagenze, mu mibare yose hamwe.
texts.sv_mr_privacy: Imibare yose hamwe gusa, yerekanwa guhera kuri {n}. Nta kintu cyerekanwa ku muntu umwe.
texts.sv_mw_intro: Hindura amagambo y'ubutumwa bujya ku bakiriya. Ubutumwa bw'umutekano, ubwirinzi n'amategeko buhora bufite amagambo asanzwe.
texts.sv_mw_languages: Amagambo yawe ahindurwa mu ndimi zose iyo ubitse. Ururimi rutatsinze igenzura rugumana amagambo asanzwe.
texts.sv_mw_limits: Inyuguti zigera kuri {chars}. Aho kuzuza: {fills}. Buri gihe gumana {must}.
texts.sv_mw_owner_approves: Nyir'ubucuruzi wenyine ni we wemeza amagambo mashya.
texts.sv_mw_owner_or_manager: Nyir'ubucuruzi cyangwa umuyobozi ni bo bonyine bahindura amagambo y'ubutumwa.
texts.sv_mw_testing: Uburyo bw'igerageza: ni wowe wenyine ubona ubu butumwa kugeza ubwemeje.
texts.sv_mw_why_missing: Gumana {business} mu magambo kugira ngo hamenyekane uwohereje.
texts.sv_mw_why_not_allowed: Ubutumwa ntibujya burimo PIN, ijambo ry'ibanga, kode, nimero y'ikarita cyangwa ihuriro rya interineti.
texts.sv_mw_why_unknown: Koresha gusa ahantu ho kuzuza hari hasi.
texts.sv_owner_only: Nyirabyo wenyine ni we ushobora kubihindura.
texts.sv_pl_intro: Buri gahunda n'imbibi zayo, n'ibimaze gukoreshwa.
texts.sv_tc_intro: Gerageza imiyoboro n'ibikora byonyine nta mpungenge: amakuru y'urugero, buri mufatanyabikorwa mu igerageza, nta butumwa bwoherejwe kandi nta mafaranga yimuwe.
texts.sv_tc_on: Kopi y'igerageza irafunguye. Ubutumwa ku bakiriya burafunze hano.
